renewal_terms: Conditional annual one-year renewals for up to ten additional years if Distributor complies with the Agreement (Section 1.3). Missing explicit renewal election or notice mechanics.
key_obligations: Company appoints Distributor as exclusive distributor in the Illinois Market (Section 1.1)
Ten-year initial term beginning on delivery of last Sample, renewable annually for up to ten additional years if Distributor complies with the Agreement (Section 1.3)
Distributor must issue an irrevocable $500,000 letter of credit (Section 1.6)
Distributor must place a $250,000 purchase order by the first day of each month (Section 1.6)
Distributor must purchase at least 375 units in the first Product Year (Section 1.6)
Distributor must submit quarterly written reports during the first year (Section 4.1)

risk_flags.issue: Missing explicit renewal election or notice mechanics.
risk_flags.suggested_redline: Add explicit language requiring Distributor to provide written notice of its election to renew at least 90 days prior to the expiration of the then-current Term.

risk_flags.issue: 30 days is the termination-notice period; the separate cure period is an undefined commercially reasonable time. Curable defaults do have that cure period.
risk_flags.suggested_redline: Replace 'commercially reasonable time' with a specific, fixed number of days (e.g., 30 days) for curing any material default after receipt of written notice.

risk_flags.issue: Company generally may, at its option, repurchase; but Company shall repurchase unopened Product when it terminates without cause for reasons other than Distributor's minimum failure. The clear mandatory exception protects that scenario; the risk is inventory exposure after other expirations or terminations, where repurchase remains optional.
risk_flags.suggested_redline: Change 'may, at its option... repurchase' to 'shall repurchase' for all Products in Distributor's possession upon any expiration or termination, regardless of cause.

risk_flags.issue: Each party covers its own breach, negligence, and IP violations; the Distributor-specific indemnity applies only when Company is not at fault.
risk_flags.suggested_redline: Remove the 'provided that Company is not at fault' condition from the Distributor’s indemnification obligation to ensure full coverage for claims arising from Distributor’s sales and marketing practices.

recommendation: Execution is not established from the visible signature page: one explicit /s/Joseph Marino mark and Jim Stump's typed signatory block are visible, but no execution dates are visible. Negotiate explicit renewal election and notice mechanics in Section 1.3; replace undefined cure period in Section 4.2 with a fixed number of days; change optional repurchase language in Section 4.4 to mandatory 'shall repurchase' for all Products upon expiration or termination regardless of cause; and remove the 'provided that Company is not at fault' condition from Distributor's indemnification obligation in Section 5.3.
